name: GratisAPI
tagline: A completely free, 100% static, open-data API.
description: GratisAPI is a collection of static JSON APIs hosted on GitHub Pages. Every endpoint is a plain JSON file: no keys, no rate limits, no tracking, no cost. Gratis means free.

apis.title: Animals
apis.description: Biological taxonomy of animals, from kingdom down to species.

apis.title: Quotes
apis.description: Memorable quotes from famous people throughout history.

apis.title: Colors
apis.description: Named web colors with hex, RGB and HSL values.

apis.title: Countries
apis.description: Countries of the world with capital, ISO codes, continent and currency.

apis.title: Continents
apis.description: The seven continents of Earth with area, population and country counts.

apis.title: Planets
apis.description: Planets and dwarf planets of the Solar System with key physical data.

apis.title: Chemical Elements
apis.description: The 118 elements of the periodic table with symbol, atomic number, mass and category.

apis.title: HTTP Status Codes
apis.description: HTTP response status codes with their standard reason phrase and category.

apis.title: Currencies
apis.description: World currencies with ISO 4217 code, symbol and minor unit.

apis.title: Languages
apis.description: Human languages with ISO 639-1 code, native name and writing direction.

apis.title: Zodiac
apis.description: The twelve signs of the Western zodiac with dates, elements and symbols.

apis.title: Calendar
apis.description: Months of the year and days of the week with ordinal, length and abbreviation.
